urgency.instructions: How soon should a human reply? Use explicit deadlines and operational impact. Spam or no-action messages are never. Flexible nonurgent requests are this month. Ordinary active requests are this week. Same-day deadlines are today. An active outage or deadline within an hour is within the hour.
criteria: Never: spam, no action or explicitly no reply needed
This week: ordinary request needing a reply
Today: a same-day deadline or blocking issue
Within the hour: active outage or a deadline under one hour
